title: Zojirushi Stainless Bento Box 600ml SZ-MA06
description_en: Zojirushi's vacuum-insulated stainless steel bento box keeps food hot for 6 hours or cold for 8. The triple-compartment design locks in flavors separately. A Japanese office worker's daily essential.
description_ja: 象印の真空断熱ステンレスランチジャー。6時間温かく・8時間冷たく保つ。3段構造でおかずの味が混ざらない。日本のビジネスパーソン定番アイテム。
